# Itemiz
> A minimalist, lightweight todo list web app with a simple and clean design.
Created by KelvinY.

## Key Features
- **Minimalist & Clean UI**: Designed for a clean, distraction-free task management experience.
- **Lightweight & Fast**: Built with PetiteVue and Tailwind CSS for instant loading.
- **Privacy-First**: Stores your tasks locally in the browser (`localStorage`).
